title: Exploit Chain: Mass Assignment Role Escalation → RBAC Bypass → Full Admin Data Access
description: Step 1: Any authenticated user (CUSTOMER/BARBER) creates a new user with role=ADMIN via POST /api/v1/users mass assignment (finding-013, CWE-915). Step 2: The newly created ADMIN user exploits broken RBAC middleware (finding-020, CWE-285) to access admin-only endpoints. Step 3: Attacker accesses GET /api/v1/users endpoints (finding-025,027, CWE-200) to exfiltrate all password hashes. Step 4: Attacker uses IDOR on customers/appointments (finding-007,008,009,010, CWE-639) to access all cross-user data.
impact: Full privilege escalation from standard user to admin with complete data exfiltration (password hashes, all customer data, all appointments, all barbers).
mitigation: 1) Remove role field from mass assignment in user creation. 2) Fix vulnerableRequireRole middleware. 3) Remove password_hash from API responses. 4) Add ownership verification in all resource endpoints.

history.details: Constructed by chaining findings finding-013, finding-020, finding-025, finding-027, finding-007, finding-008, finding-009, finding-010.
